title: All active filters combine with AND logic
preconds:
1. You are on the Parts Velocity report with data loaded.
2. You know one part's type, category, and vendor..
steps:
1. Set the Type filter to that part's type.
2. Add the part's category in the Category filter.
3. Add a vendor that is NOT the part's vendor in the Vendor filter.
4. Change the Vendor filter to the part's actual vendor.
expected:
1. After steps 1-2 the part is still listed (it satisfies both filters).
2. After step 3 the part disappears - a part must satisfy EVERY active filter to appear (AND logic, not OR).
3. After step 4 the part is listed again.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Parts Velocity report specification version 11 (S2-R7), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-d0e135e on 8/19/2026.
Re-checked against the live specification on 26 August 2026: the requirements this case cites are unchanged, so only the version cited above was updated.
